issue.title: test_macro_string_literals_avoid_xprompt_terms fails: 2268f50d79 split moved allowlisted %xprompts_enabled strings to a new test file

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic AST string scan; fails identically on a clean tree at master 3a4178b15a (2026-10-07, found during the sase-1hf landing check). Findings: `tests/history/test_continuation_replay_hydration_basic.py: string '"%xprompts_enabled:false\\n"'` and `'"% xprompts_enabled:false"'`. Root cause: 2268f50d79 (toobig split of the continuation replay hydration tests, agent toobig-7b) moved these legacy-directive literals into a new module that `_MACRO_STRING_ALLOWLIST` in tests/_macro_terminology_strings.py does not list. Fix: re-key the allowlist entries (with their existing reason) to the new file path, or remove them if the old path's entries are now stale.

issue.creation_reason: The macro terminology guard is red on master because a toobig test split moved allowlisted legacy-directive literals; found while landing sase-1hf.
